description:
Implement the v0.1 slice of the adapter contract specified in bl-415c
(ARCH §4.4) for the Anthropic provider. This is the follow-up that
bl-415c's description and the README's 'Providers' note both defer.

=== Scope ===
- New binary target lernie-provider-anthropic at src/bin/lernie-provider-anthropic.rs.
- Subcommands: describe (prints JSON per ARCH §4.4) and complete (reads
  JSON request on stdin; non-streaming response on stdout).
- Library module src/provider/anthropic.rs stays as the shared wire
  code (serde types, HTTP client). The binary wraps it.
- In-band errors per the contract: top-level {type:'error', kind, http_status,
  message, retry_after_seconds}. Exit 0 on valid output (including
  type:error); non-zero only on adapter crash.
- SIGTERM handler that drops the in-flight request and exits within 5s.
  For non-streaming this is effectively a clean exit(0); no partial
  state to flush.
- Env-var auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY forwarded by name via describe.auth_env.
- schema_version: 1.

=== Explicit non-goals ===
- Streaming / SSE. That is bl-d15d.
- Tool-use wire shape. That arrives in v0.3.
- Prompt caching headers.
- Harness-side adapter discovery / invocation code. There are no
  harness call sites today (bl-e048 is unimplemented); this task
  delivers the binary and its contract only. Harness integration is
  a separate task, filed when bl-e048 is picked up.

=== Testing ===
- Integration tests under tests/adapter_anthropic.rs that invoke the
  binary as a subprocess with httpmock standing in for api.anthropic.com.
- Cover: describe output well-formed; complete happy path returns
  expected JSON; 429 maps to kind:retryable with retry_after_seconds;
  5xx maps to kind:retryable; 400 maps to kind:fatal; malformed
  upstream JSON surfaces as kind:fatal.
- 100% line coverage via cargo tarpaulin --fail-under 100.
- All existing tests continue to pass.

=== Interaction with bl-e048 ===
bl-e048 ('prompt' subcommand) depends on bl-9600 (the in-process client).
After this ball lands, bl-e048 should be re-pointed at the adapter
binary rather than the in-process client. That re-pointing is bl-e048's
problem, not this one.

=== Done-when ===
cargo test, tarpaulin --fail-under 100, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check
all green. The binary is documented in README's Providers section.
ARCH §4.4 and TAXONOMY §2 remain accurate.
title: Anthropic adapter: extract into lernie-provider-anthropic binary
